rca_of_the_issue: BUG (reported): In Bajaj NOC PDF, the 'Details of Purchaser' table was breaking and overlapping at the page boundary. ROOT CAUSE: .details-table had no table-layout:fixed (long content stretched columns) and no page-break-inside:avoid on tr — so when the 'Project Location / Address' row wrapped over multiple lines, WeasyPrint would split that row across pages; the partial bottom portion on page 1 and the partial top portion on page 2 each drew their own borders, producing visible overlap with the neighbouring row's border. FIX (verified in generate_noc_bajaj_html only): added (a) table-layout: fixed so widths are predictable, (b) tr { page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; } so a row that doesn't fit moves wholesale to the next page, and (c) vertical-align: top + word-wrap: break-word + overflow-wrap: anywhere on th/td so content wraps inside the cell instead of distorting layout. VERIFICATION: 7/7 pytest tests green; per-page pdftotext shows the long address row stays on page 1 as a single unit, and the table partitions cleanly across pages with no label appearing on both pages (test_rows_partition_across_pages). HDFC NOC regression also passes.
